Excellent Home Cooked Food with Awesome Vibes and great location !!
Apr 2026 • Friends
We are group of 20 people traveling to Vietnam from 5-15th April from a group tour that was inclusive of lunch & Dinner. When we were in Hanoi, Mr Ram who is the owner of this restaurant called me at Night and asked us what we would like for Dinner. I think this was the most beautiful thing to happen. He asked me before every meal and served Pav Bhaji / South Indian Dishes / Chinese food / Chole Bahtura / Punjabi food, all with our choices. The staff was excellent, especially Satveer and Miss Thu & they served delicious meals wholeheartedly. The ambience was very good with awesome vibes and excellent location. I would recommend everyone to visit this place if you are in Danang. Very well done & best wishes going ahead 👍👍❤️👌

Absolutely wonderful food and service
Jan 2024 • Family
Our last night at Da Nang we decided to go for the Indian food. Since Veda Kitchen was close to our hotel and had a very good review we decided to land there.
I would request everyone please don't go by the look of the restaurant. It's modest but the food...it was beyond my expectations to say the least. We ordered Chilli chicken, Dal Makhni, lacha Paratha, butter naan. It was soon good. I have seen lacha paratha so flakes in only a few good restaurants. Dal Makhni was really nice and had this beautiful nutty flavour. Chilli chicken was relished by the boys. 
They were really generous with the onion salad, they eon us over that. 😁. 
If you are in Vietnam and craving for some lovely Indian food, please do visit here.
